problem: No strategy can be ranked because no verified market price exists anywhere in the repo.
recommendation: Adopt one sanctioned price source decision before any leaderboard work resumes: either a licensed-operator data agreement or a public quote archive whose terms permit retention; record the decision in COORDINATION.md.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Unblocks G4 (CLV), the residual columns, and the two-stage leaderboard end to end.
notes: Every desk has left market columns blank; the blocker is a policy decision, not engineering.

problem: Model outputs are spread across desks with different schemas, so nothing can be compared.
recommendation: Standardize the output contract this desk used (probability triple + inputs_sha256 + opened_utc + source_url) as the repo-wide model-output schema.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Lets any future model output be audited, replayed and scored uniformly; directly implements R035 repo-wide.
notes: Schema already exercised by 39 rows in this desk.

problem: Availability snapshots exist only where a session happened to run (two reads, six days apart).
recommendation: Add a scheduled workflow (Wed/Fri/Sun to kickoff) owned by one session, writing immutable hashed captures to a single agreed directory, with a freshness alert.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Turns the point-in-time ledger from an artifact into a series; enables Questionable-to-Out replay for backtests (R047/R048/R065).
notes: Design proposal only; the owning session must claim it in COORDINATION.md to avoid duplicate jobs.

problem: The one-pass HFA estimate is noisy and unbounded; decisions relying on it inherit that silently.
recommendation: Pre-register a bootstrap (games resampled) 95% interval for HFA and sigma, published next to each fair line once implemented.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Decision-makers see which Week 11 edges are inside the noise band instead of treating point estimates as sharp.
notes: Requires a new spec version (the current one is frozen); propose as v2.

problem: Game-status rows that contradict practice status (e.g., Limited Participation + Out) are indistinguishable from parse errors.
recommendation: Publish a conflict flag per row in the capture CSV (level and delta), so downstream users can filter or require confirmation.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Prevents bad availability features from inheriting contradictions silently; directly implements the conflict-flag requirement in R048.
notes: Contradictions observed on the 2026-11-18 read are listed on the Flagged page (F-P11).

problem: Venue transcription (R042) is 1 of 13 fixtures; venues matter for neutral-site HFA and weather overlays.
recommendation: Batch-transcribe the remaining 12 Week 11 game centres with stamped reads, or capture the venues from the weekly schedule API if one is documented.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Completes the fixture-context set needed before any weather/roof feature is added (R066).
notes: Each game-centre page is one fetch; the pattern is proven by the MIN@SF read.

problem: Leaderboards elsewhere in the repo could still be read as rankings even when every metric cell is blank.
recommendation: Adopt this desk's rule everywhere: a leaderboard row without a benchmark-relative proper score and n is rendered as NOT ELIGIBLE in the row itself, not only in a footnote.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Removes the last way a lucky staking run can be mistaken for signal (R006/R010).
notes: Origin-desk leaderboard already separates signal from staking; this hardens the display contract.

problem: Delta ledgers currently compare across sessions' namespaces, which is fragile.
recommendation: Keep one canonical injuries/depth/inactives ledger directory agreed in COORDINATION.md; desks append stamped reads, nobody overwrites.
expected_impact_on_decisions: Makes the point-in-time series durable across sessions; prevents forked histories that cannot be reconciled.
notes: This desk's read joins a decision-desk capture; a canonical directory removes the cross-namespace dependency.
